biography: I am an Afghan and Persian DJ based in Malmö, bringing Afghan, Persian, Kurdish and international music together for multicultural weddings, birthdays, graduation parties, corporate events and club nights.

My experience includes Afghan-Danish and Afghan-Kurdish weddings, Persian celebrations and family parties. From Malmö and Eslöv to Uppsala and live events in Berlin, I tailor every set to the people, cultures and energy on the dance floor.
Music is not just my profession – it's my passion. For me, being a DJ is about bringing people together, creating emotions and turning special occasions into unforgettable memories.
With years of experience behind the decks and an extensive music library, I offer professional DJ services for weddings, private parties, birthdays, corporate events and club nights.

My ability to read the crowd, feel the energy and play the right track at the right moment makes every performance unique. From timeless classics and international hits to oriental rhythms and modern beats, I tailor my music to your vision and the atmosphere of your event.
Throughout my journey, I have had the pleasure of meeting incredible people, building valuable collaborations and being part of countless memorable celebrations.
My musical journey continues, and I look forward to bringing my passion, energy and experience to your next event.
You bring the people. I bring the music, the energy and the atmosphere.
See you on the dance floor!
